description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the complete Front Axle & Steering Knuckle Rebuild Kit.
Get everything you need to completely rebuild your Front Axles & Knuckles.
Comes with King Pins & Bearings PLUS Front Axle Bearings & Oil Seals!
This Kits Even Includes the Chuck Nuts, Lock Washers & Torque Washers!
DOES BOTH SIDES!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
KNUCKLE
Qty 4 – King Pins (may need minor sanding to fit bearings)
Qty 4 – King Pin Bearings
Qty 4 – Shims for King Pins
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seals
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Felts
Qty 4 – Retainer Plate, Knuckle Oil Seal
Qty 4 – Cover Plate, Knuckle Oil Seal
FRONT AXLES
Qty 2 – Inner Bearings
Qty 2 – Outer Bearings
Qty 2 – Inner Oil Seals
Qty 2 – Outer Oil Seals
Qty 4 – Chuck Nuts
Qty 2 – Lock Washers
Qty 2 – Torque Washers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
